svg.title: GLP-1-type drugs vs placebo for drinking: seven trials
svg.desc: GLP-1-type drugs vs placebo for drinking: seven trials. Exenatide, Denmark, 2022, 127 people, vs Placebo + CBT: Main goal missed. Dulaglutide, Switzerland, 2023*, 151 people, vs Placebo: 29% less alcohol. Semaglutide, Denmark, 2026, 108 people, vs Placebo + CBT: Main goal met. Pemvidutide (RECLAIM), 2026, 100 people, vs Placebo: Main goal met (topline). Oral semaglutide, US, 2026, 50 people, vs Placebo: Main goal missed. Semaglutide, US, 2025, 48 people, vs Placebo: Main goal met (lab test). Mazdutide (Lilly), 2025-26, 308 people, vs Placebo: Finished; no results posted.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 892 people in total, most for 8 to 26 weeks. None was large enough to win approval.
